title: Finite covering transport across evaluation equivalences
statement: For categories A,B with a shared object universe and an independent shared hom universe, a functor p:A→B and a precoverage P on B, define Q = finite(A) ∩ p^{-1}P. If P has singleton isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition, finite indexed base change and covering pullbacks, and p is an equivalence, Q has singleton isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition, finite indexed base change and covering pullbacks. All Q-covering presieves are finite. A section e of p preserves and reflects covers when every P-covering presieve is finite, and every indexed Q-cover lifts through e up to isomorphisms. Transitions compared with original transitions preserve coverings and their pullbacks.

source.place: Situation 0A34, Lemmas 00WW, 00WX and 03CB; finite-family covering axioms of 00VH

proof.text: Intersect finite(A) with comap P. Map each finite indexed composite and each finite indexed pullback family into P and apply the finite axioms there. An equivalence preserves and creates pullbacks. The section equation gives covering reflection, and images of finite presieves are finite. To compare naturally isomorphic functors, index a finite presieve by its distinct arrows and use finite base change along the isomorphism components. Apply this comparison to lift coverings and to transport transition covering preservation. Pullback preservation follows by equivalence reflection. The argument works when the object universe is larger than the hom universe.
